[[File:Skeleton icon.png|left]]
'''Skeletons''' are a common [[undead]] monster found all over [[Gielinor]]. Like [[zombies]], they are the result of a [[necromancer]] reanimating the bodies of the dead. As such, they are commonly found in tombs, graveyards and [[dungeons]].

According to [[Azzanadra]], skeletons can also reanimate themselves should their burial site be desecrated, which is further supported when attempting to loot [[Skeleton (Ancient Cavern)|barbarian skeletons]] in the [[Ancient Cavern]].

They are generally weak to magic, with most skeletons being especially vulnerable to [[Earth spells|earth]] or [[water spells]]. A [[salve amulet]] or [[salve amulet (e)]] will provide a damage and accuracy boost of +15% and +20% respectively against skeletons and other undead.

==Slayer alternatives==
{{Main|Skeletons (Slayer assignment)}}
Any monsters named "skeleton", with the exception of [[Skeleton (player-owned house)|guard skeletons]] in a player-owned house and the [[Skeleton (Daemonheim)|skeleton]]s found in [[Daemonheim]] (also including the [[unholy cursebearer]] boss) and [[Sinkholes]], may be killed to complete a [[Skeletons (Slayer assignment)|slayer assignment]]. The following alternatives are also available:
* [[Ankou]]
* [[Bound skeleton]]s
* [[Skeleton mage]]s
* [[Skeletal miner]]s
* [[Skeletal hand]]s
* [[Skeleton Fremennik]]s
* [[Skeleton warlord]]s
* [[Skoblin]]s

==Banking tips==
Many skeleton locations are far from banks. For players wishing to slay skeletons and bank their drops, consider the following:
* The [[Draynor Sewers]] are moderately close to the [[Draynor bank]].
* The [[Lair of Tarn Razorlor (dungeon)|Lair of Tarn Razorlor]] has a banker. However, using this dungeon requires the [[Haunted Mine]] quest, [[Lair of Tarn Razorlor (miniquest)|Lair of Tarn Razorlor]] miniquest, and a 100 coin payment to the banker for each access to the bank.
* The skeleton cave in the [[Chaos Tunnels]] is easily accessed from entrance #1 to tunnels and is thus moderately close to the [[Edgeville bank]]. However, care should be taken in that entrance #1 is in low-level [[Wilderness]] and also enters the cave with rather dangerous [[gargoyle]]s. Aggressive [[zombie]]s in the cave with the skeletons may interfere with skeleton hunting.
* [[Skeletal hand]]s may also be slain in the [[Meiyerditch tunnels]] if the player looking for good drops from skeletons.

==Champion's Challenge==
Skeletons have a lesser champion, the [[Skeleton Champion]], available to fight as part of the [[Champion's Challenge]]. To fight the Skeleton Champion, the player must kill skeletons until they obtain the very rare [[Skeleton Champion's scroll]] drop. Obtaining the scroll can takes several hours of dedicated skeleton hunting, therefore it is advised to kill lower level skeletons to increase the kill rate as much as possible.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Part 2 - Combat Style Modernisation|date=2 March 2026}}
** Default base hit chances increased:
*** Magic ('weak'): 65 → 70
*** Melee ('same'): 55 → 60
*** Ranged ('strong'): 45 → 50

* {{UL|type=update|update=Patch Notes: Early-Game Rebalance|date=16 February 2026}}
** A number of early-game mobs will once again drop actual armour, weapons, ores, and bars.
*** Copper stone spirit → Bronze bar
*** Iron stone spirit → Iron ore
*** Tiny spiky iron salvage (unarmed skeletons) → Iron dagger/Iron off-hand dagger
*** Tiny spiky iron salvage (armed skeletons) → Iron sword/Iron off-hand sword
*** Small bladed iron salvage → Iron scimitar/Iron off-hand scimitar
*** Tiny plated iron salvage → Iron med helm

* {{UL|type=patch|update=MHAW & Double XP - This Week In RuneScape|date=15 May 2023}}
** Updated models for skeletons, [[zombie]]s and [[giant rat]]s within the [[Wilderness]], giving them the new [[Unwelcome Guests]] models.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Skeletons can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=ninja|update=Patch Notes (2 March 2015)|date=2 March 2015}}
** A large number of skeletons across Gielinor have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (16 February 2015)|date=16 February 2015}}
** Some skeletons no longer shoot rocks out of their bows.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (5 July 2010)|date=5 July 2010}}
** The new skeletons and [[goblins]] in the [[Lumbridge Catacombs]] can now also drop [[champion scrolls]].

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (9 November 2009)|date=9 November 2009}}
** Reworked various [[zombie]] and skeleton combat animations.

* {{UL|type=patch|update=Patch Notes (7 October 2009)|date=7 October 2009}}
** Updated the skull of a skeleton to match the rest of its, er, body.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The Lair of Tarn Razorlor|date=22 January 2007}}
** [[Zombie]]s, skeletons and [[ghost]]s have been graphically updated.

* {{UL|type=update|update=Runescape beta is now online!|date=4 January 2001}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
* The level 58 skeletons in the Crandor and Karamja Dungeon are bigger than the other skeletons.
* The skeletons in the Barrows did not drop the champion scroll for several years. This bug was eventually fixed.
* When in a player-owned-house oubliette or dungeon when building mode is on, they are called Bones.
* In the [[2011 Halloween event]], the player has to choose a skeleton to represent [[Pestilence]] in statue form.
